prompt:
You are a senior typographer and information designer. You lay out data tables for publication. You judge layouts by looking at the rendered result as a whole: what the table is for, how a reader scans and compares it, which columns belong together or play the same role, proportion and rhythm across columns, a clear hierarchy of headers and groups, whether rows read as units, whether words, numbers and identifiers stay intact, and how text and white space are distributed. Fewer lines or a shorter table is not automatically better, and neither is equal widths or symmetry; decide case by case and say why.

Table: 会议室预订周视图（5/12–5/16） (language zh-CN).
Grid: 6 columns × 7 rows. Row headers: yes (first logical column identifies each row).
Merged cells: "2025 春季校园招聘宣讲会（09:00–17:" spans 3 col × 1 row; "产品需求评审（09:00–12:00）｜A301" spans 1 col × 2 row; "新员工入职培训（13:30–16:30）｜C20" spans 1 col × 2 row; "客户方案演示与答疑（13:30–16:30）｜A" spans 1 col × 2 row.
Per-column content facts (content px at 15px font, excluding padding):
  col 1: header "时间段" · longest unbreakable word 53px · one-line width 94px
  col 2: header "周一（5/12）" · longest unbreakable word 65px · one-line width 261px
  col 3: header "周二（5/13）" · longest unbreakable word 65px · one-line width 214px
  col 4: header "周三（5/14）" · longest unbreakable word 63px · one-line width 274px
  col 5: header "周四（5/15）" · longest unbreakable word 63px · one-line width 304px
  col 6: header "周五（5/16）" · longest unbreakable word 62px · one-line width 190px
Each column also has 21px of padding+border, so a column given width w px shows w−21 px of text.
Available width: 360px (the dashed pink box = the reader's viewport). The column widths you choose must sum to at most 359px.
This table cannot fit without splitting words at 360px. You MAY choose a total wider than 359px (the reader then scrolls horizontally), or squeeze and accept splits — a design decision.
Rendering convention: the screenshot always shows the WHOLE table. Anything beyond the dashed box is not clipped; it is the part a reader reaches by scrolling sideways, so judge both what fits in the box at first sight and the cost of scrolling to the rest.
Fixed: content, font, 15px font size, padding, borders, colours, alignment. You control ONLY the column widths.

Your understanding so far: {"purpose":"展示一周内各时段的会议室预订，帮助读者查找活动并比较每天的安排。","reading":"先按左侧时间段定位，再横向查看各天；也可沿某一天纵向浏览。跨列活动表示覆盖多个日期，跨行活动表示持续多个时段。","groups":["第1列是时间索引，需要与各日期列清楚区分。","第2至第6列分别代表周一至周五，作用相同，应保持相近的视觉权重；较长的活动内容可获得适度额外宽度。"],"keep_intact":["时间段和活动中的时间范围","日期、会议室编号及其他标识符","跨行和跨列活动的覆盖关系"],"may_wrap":["活动名称可在自然词界或标点处换行。","活动名称、时间和会议室编号之间可换行。","跨行活动已有的高度可以容纳部分换行。"]}

The first image is the one-line content overview. The other images are real browser renders of your current designs:
Design r1A: widths [115, 100, 95, 105, 105, 95] · table 616×604px · row heights [60, 60, 106, 106, 83, 106, 83] · column headers wrapped 5/6 · tallest cell 5 lines · mid-word splits 0 · OVERFLOWS the box by 256px
Design r1B: widths [115, 110, 105, 115, 120, 105] · table 671×580px · row heights [60, 60, 106, 106, 60, 106, 83] · column headers wrapped 3/6 · tallest cell 5 lines · mid-word splits 0 · OVERFLOWS the box by 311px
Design r1C: widths [115, 90, 90, 95, 95, 90] · table 576×627px · row heights [60, 60, 106, 129, 83, 106, 83] · column headers wrapped 5/6 · tallest cell 6 lines · mid-word splits 0 · OVERFLOWS the box by 216px

Look carefully at each render as a whole and in detail. For each design say what works and what is visually wrong, and WHY it happens (which width causes it). Then propose up to 3 improved designs: refine the most promising, fix the problems you saw, and try a new idea if an important alternative is unexplored. If no design can be meaningfully improved, set "done": true and return no new designs.
Reply ONLY JSON: {"critique":[{"design":"name","good":"","problems":"","cause":""}],"done":false,"designs":[{"name":"short-name","widths":[int px],"change":"what you changed and why"}]}

log.raw: {"critique":[{"design":"r1A","good":"时间段完整且醒目，周一至周五的列宽接近，便于把同一时段的安排横向比较；活动标识符没有出现词中断裂。","problems":"日期表头大多分成两行，多个活动的名称、时间和会议室编号被拆成较多短行；首屏只容纳时间列、周一、周二及周三的一小部分，后几天需要横向滚动。","cause":"时间列115px足以放下时间段，但日期列只有95–105px，扣除21px内边距和边框后，活动内容区较窄；总宽616px超过视口256px。"},{"design":"r1B","good":"日期列适度加宽后，部分表头和活动内容更完整，表格高度降到580px；时间索引和跨行预订仍有清楚的阅读结构。","problems":"部分活动的时间范围仍跨行，长活动依然形成高单元格；首屏中周三露出更少，查看周末之前的全部日期需要更多横向滚动。","cause":"日期列105–120px比r1A宽，但扣除21px后仍不足以容纳所有时间范围和较长活动片段；总宽671px，超出视口311px。"},{"design":"r1C","good":"总宽576px，三种方案中横向滚动最少，首屏能看到更多周三内容；时间段保持完整，日期列的视觉权重也比较一致。","problems":"活动名称和时间被切成更多短行，最长单元格达到6行，表格更高；密集换行削弱了同一行内不同日期的可比较性。日期表头仍大多换行。","cause":"日期列压到90–95px后，实际内容宽仅69–74px，周三、周四的较长内容尤其拥挤；缩窄也没有消除216px的横向溢出。"}],"done":false,"designs":[{"name":"balanced-refine","widths":[115,110,105,115,115,105],"change":"以r1B为基础，周四略收窄5px，保留较长内容列的空间，并让日期列维持相近权重；检验能否接近r1B的高度，同时稍减横向滚动。"},{"name":"time-ranges","widths":[115,125,120,125,130,120],"change":"适度加宽所有日期列，重点检验活动时间范围和日期表头能否更完整地显示，以及更少的短行是否值得增加横向滚动。"},{"name":"compact-middle","widths":[115,100,95,110,110,95],"change":"在r1A基础上给内容较长的周三、周四更多空间，周一、周二和周五维持较紧凑宽度；检验能否控制滚动，同时改善中间日期的拥挤。"}]}
